name: @role-orchestrator/desktop-ui
description: M11-01 desktop renderer foundation: the product UI served at /app (React + TypeScript + Vite + React Router + Lucide, whitelist-only dependencies). Built as ONE inline single-file HTML artifact (assets inlined by a local Vite plugin, no extra npm dependency) that local-api serves with a content-hash CSP; the desktop shell's default URL points here and authenticates via the shell's loopback Authorization injection (ADR docs/adr/010-token-auto-session.md). Zero runtime dependency on any workspace package — it talks to local-api over HTTP only.
